OMIM disease: 15q26 deletion associated phenotypes (congenital heart, skeletal, and kidney disease) / 16p13.3 microduplication syndrome
1p36 deletion syndrome / 17q25 associated phenotypes (congenital heart disease)

Evidence for embryonic lethality: The COL1A1 variant is a known pathogenic variant in type I osteogenesis imperfecta (ClinVar ID 1410496). Pathogenic COL1A1 variants cause osteogenesis imperfecta to a varying degree of severity. Lethality of COL1A1 variants has been described (PMID: 18412368), and reportedly depends on whether or not the variant is a mutation of a glycine residue and which amino acid replaces glycine. Based on criteria by Bodian et al. (PMID: 18412368) COL1A1(NM_000088.4):c.931G>C p.(Gly311Arg) classifies as a lethal variant.
Biallelic variants in CPLANE1 have been reported as the cause of early pregnancy loss (PMID: 38351681). A deficit of biallelic loss-of-function of CPLANE1 has been reported (PMID:37301908).

CSNK2B is a developmental disease gene associated with a range of severity in neurodevelopmental and epilepsy phenotypes (PMID: 34041744). Embryonic lethality in humans has not yet been described, but based on observed phenotypes in CK2β knockout mice, presenting as post-implantation lethality, a phenotypic expansion could be argued. CK2β has been shown to be crucial for development of the central nervous in mice, as well as organogenesis (PMID: 20368359).
Biallelic variants in DHCR7 have been reported as the cause of embryonic lethality (PMID: 22226660). A deficit of homozygosity for this variant is described in PMID:37301908.
DNMT1 loss is lethal in human embryonic stem cells (PMID: 25822089). DNMT1 is highly constrained for pLoF variants, and there is no other pLoF variant in DNMT1 in gnomAD.
FGFR2 has been reported to result in a severe Mendelian condition (PMID: 7987400), and is reportedly essental in early mammalian embryonic development (PMID: 10518547).

OMIM disease: Intellectual disability-severe speech delay-mild dysmorphism syndrome
Evidence for embryonic lethality: FOXP1 is linked to a severe Mendelian condition (PMID: 27657687).

OMIM disease: Cardiomyopathy, dilated, 1JJ; Familial isolated dilated cardiomyopathy
Evidence for embryonic lethality: LAMA4 pathogenic sequence variants are associated with cardiomyopathy (PMID: 17646580). A variant in LAMA4 has been reported in selective abortion due to hydrops fetalis (DOI: 10.1007/s40556-021-00318-2).

RANBP2 mutations can be fatal through viral-triggered encephalopathy (PMID: 19118815), and Ranbp2 knockout in mice has been shown to be embryonic lethal (PMID: 17069463). The gene is highly constrained for loss-of-function variants, and no pLoF in RANBP2 reaches elevated frequencies in reference datasets.

OMIM disease: Neurodevelopmental disorder with dysmorphic facies and distal skeletal anomalies
Evidence for embryonic lethality: ZMIZ1 is linked to a severe neurodevelopmental disease, and knockout mice display embryonic lethality during organogenesis (PMID: 30639322).
